title: Bad Habits

cues.en: Every time you come around, you know I can't say no.
cues.zh: 每次你來的時候，你都知道我不能拒絕。
cues.text: Every time you come around, you know I can't say no.

cues.en: Every time the sun goes down, I let you take control.
cues.zh: 每次太陽下山的時候，我都會讓你掌控一切。
cues.text: Every time the sun goes down, I let you take control.

cues.en: I can feel the paradise before my world implodes.
cues.zh: 在我的世界崩潰之前我就能感受到天堂。
cues.text: I can feel the paradise before my world implodes.

cues.en: And tonight had something wonderful.
cues.zh: 今晚發生了一些美妙的事情。
cues.text: And tonight had something wonderful.

cues.en: My bad habits lead to late, nice and in alone.
cues.zh: 我的壞習慣導致遲到、乖巧和孤獨。
cues.text: My bad habits lead to late, nice and in alone.

cues.en: Conversations with a stranger are barely nope.
cues.zh: 與陌生人交談幾乎是不可能的。
cues.text: Conversations with a stranger are barely nope.

cues.en: Swearing this will be the last, but it probably won't.
cues.zh: 發誓這將是最後一次，但很可能不會。
cues.text: Swearing this will be the last, but it probably won't.

cues.en: I got nothing left to lose, all used.
cues.zh: 我已經沒有什麼好失去的了，一切都已被利用。
cues.text: I got nothing left to lose, all used.

cues.en: I'll do my bad habits lead to late, nice and in space.
cues.zh: 我會改正我的壞習慣導致遲到，好在太空。
cues.text: I'll do my bad habits lead to late, nice and in space.

cues.en: And I know I lose control of the things that I say.
cues.zh: 我知道我對自己所說的話失去了控制。
cues.text: And I know I lose control of the things that I say.

cues.en: I was looking for a way out now, I can't escape.
cues.zh: 我現在正在尋找出路，我無法逃脫。
cues.text: I was looking for a way out now, I can't escape.

cues.en: Nothing happens after two, it's true, it's true.
cues.zh: 兩點之後什麼事也沒發生，這是真的，這是真的。
cues.text: Nothing happens after two, it's true, it's true.

cues.en: My bad habits lead to you.
cues.zh: 我的壞習慣導致了你。
cues.text: My bad habits lead to you.

cues.en: Every pure intention lands when the good times start.
cues.zh: 當美好時光開始時，每一個純粹的意圖都會落地。
cues.text: Every pure intention lands when the good times start.

cues.en: Falling over everything to reach the first time spark.
cues.zh: 摔倒一切才到達第一次火花。
cues.text: Falling over everything to reach the first time spark.

cues.en: You started on a neon light, and then it all got dark.
cues.zh: 一開始是霓虹燈，然後天就黑了。
